course.title: Unit 3 Keep Fit【例句】
course.description: Section B How is exercise good for us?

sentences.content: How are sport and exercise good for us?
sentences.english: How are sport and exercise good for us ?
sentences.chinese: 运动和锻炼对我们有哪些益处？

sentences.content: I like skateboarding very much.
sentences.english: I like skateboarding very much
sentences.chinese: 我非常喜欢滑板运动。

sentences.content: My friends and I practise at a special park twice a week.
sentences.english: My friends and I practise at a special park twice a week
sentences.chinese: 我和朋友们每周在一个特别的公园练习两次。

sentences.content: My skateboard is really cool, and so are theirs.
sentences.english: My skateboard is really cool , and so are theirs
sentences.chinese: 我的滑板真的很酷，他们的也是。

sentences.content: We encourage one another to do tricks.
sentences.english: We encourage one another to do tricks
sentences.chinese: 我们互相鼓励表演绝活。

sentences.content: Some tricks are difficult, but once you succeed, you feel great!
sentences.english: Some tricks are difficult , but once you succeed , you feel great !
sentences.chinese: 有些技巧虽难掌握，但一旦成功，便会感到无比畅快！

sentences.content: I like skateboarding because it keeps me fit.
sentences.english: I like skateboarding because it keeps me fit
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢滑板运动，因为它能让我保持健康。

wordDetails.definition: keep（第三人称单数）: 保持

sentences.content: This year, my goal is to be really fit.
sentences.english: This year , my goal is to be really fit
sentences.chinese: 今年的目标是真正保持健康体魄。

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

sentences.content: I jog, swim, and do sit-ups.
sentences.english: I jog , swim , and do sit-ups
sentences.chinese: 我慢跑、游泳和做仰卧起坐。

sentences.content: But my favourite way of keeping fit is to use an exercise app to work out.
sentences.english: But my favourite way of keeping fit is to use an exercise app to work out
sentences.chinese: 但我最喜欢的健身方式是使用运动应用程序来锻炼。

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

sentences.content: The app gives me exercises to do every day.
sentences.english: The app gives me exercises to do every day
sentences.chinese: 这款应用每天都会给我提供锻炼内容。

wordDetails.definition: give（第三人称单数）: 给予

sentences.content: It can show my progress.
sentences.english: It can show my progress
sentences.chinese: 它可以显示我的进度。

sentences.content: My friends use the app too.
sentences.english: My friends use the app too
sentences.chinese: 我的朋友们也用这个应用。

sentences.content: We have fun when we keep fit together!
sentences.english: We have fun when we keep fit together !
sentences.chinese: 我们一起健身时其乐无穷！

sentences.content: I’m in my school’s baseball club, so I play baseball quite often.
sentences.english: I'm in my school's baseball club , so I play baseball quite often
sentences.chinese: 我是学校棒球俱乐部的成员，所以经常打棒球。

sentences.content: It’s my favourite sport.
sentences.english: It's my favourite sport
sentences.chinese: 这是我最喜爱的运动。

sentences.content: We play many matches.
sentences.english: We play many matches
sentences.chinese: 我们参加了很多场比赛。

sentences.content: The other teams are great, but I think ours is the best!
sentences.english: The other teams are great , but I think ours is the best !
sentences.chinese: 其他团队都很优秀，但我认为我们的是最棒的！

sentences.content: We usually practise three times a week after school.
sentences.english: We usually practise three times a week after school
sentences.chinese: 我们通常每周放学后练习三次。

sentences.content: We also exercise a lot because it keeps us fit and helps us play better.
sentences.english: We also exercise a lot because it keeps us fit and helps us play better
sentences.chinese: 我们还经常锻炼身体，因为这能让我们保持健康，并有助于提升运动表现。

wordDetails.definition: keep（第三人称单数）: 保持
help（第三人称单数）: 帮助

sentences.content: Baseball also builds team spirit.
sentences.english: Baseball also builds team spirit
sentences.chinese: 棒球运动还能培养团队精神。

wordDetails.definition: build（第三人称单数）: 建立

sentences.content: All of us are good friends, both on and off the field.
sentences.english: All of us are good friends , both on and off the field
sentences.chinese: 无论在场上还是场下，我们都是好朋友。

sentences.content: We work as a team, and we win or lose as a team.
sentences.english: We work as a team , and we win or lose as a team
sentences.chinese: 我们是一个团队，荣辱与共。

sentences.content: My favourite sport is swimming.
sentences.english: My favourite sport is swimming
sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢的运动是游泳。

sentences.content: It’s fun to swim and play with my friends in the water.
sentences.english: It's fun to swim and play with my friends in the water
sentences.chinese: 和朋友们在水里游泳玩耍很有趣。

sentences.content: Also, I like swimming because the cool water feels great when it’s hot.
sentences.english: Also , I like swimming because the cool water feels great when it's hot
sentences.chinese: 此外，我喜欢游泳，因为天气炎热时，清凉的水感觉非常舒服。

wordDetails.definition: feel（第三人称单数）: 感觉

sentences.content: I go swimming two or three times a week.
sentences.english: I go swimming two or three times a week
sentences.chinese: 我每周游泳两到三次。

sentences.content: Swimming is good for me because it keeps me healthy.
sentences.english: Swimming is good for me because it keeps me healthy
sentences.chinese: 游泳对我有益，因为它能让我保持健康。

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是
keep（第三人称单数现在时）: 保持

sentences.content: It is good exercise for my body.
sentences.english: It is good exercise for my body
sentences.chinese: 这对我的身体是很好的锻炼。

sentences.content: I think everyone should try it!
sentences.english: I think everyone should try it !
sentences.chinese: 我认为每个人都应该试试！
